title: ZEB1, a novel junctional adhesion molecule A regulator, impacts sensitivity of pancreatic cancer-associated fibroblasts to reovirus
model: RLT-PSC pancreatic stellate (CAF-like) cells, genome-wide Brunello knockout library, surface JAM-A FACS sort
contrast: JAM-A high vs low bin (2 vs 2)
paper_method: MAGeCK RRA, each replicate scored separately; hits consistent across both
paper_calls: ZEB1 and FGFR1 the strongest negative regulators of JAM-A (both validated); F11R (the JAM-A gene) the top positive control
barcs_calls: 19 genes at FDR 0.10 (9 enriched, 10 depleted); no control null (only 4 CTRL guides)
verdict: BARCS puts ZEB1 at #1 and FGFR1 at #5, the paper's two validated negative regulators, with the JAM-A-gene positive control F11R at #3, so the headline reproduces; the rest of the top lists diverge because the two replicates are noisy and the paper scored them separately, and with only 4 control guides the FDR cannot be calibrated.
